unknownPoolPolicy: Primary: categorical pool value -1 (missing). Preserve actual observed price features and known GPU category.
proxyPolicy: Secondary: average un-clipped predicted deltas across all trained Stockholm pools with the exact instance type; then rescale/add current price/clip once. Never choose a proxy using evaluation errors.
unseenHardwarePolicy: GPU family absent from supported training identities uses persistence; do not conflate new hardware with new regions.
selectionPolicy: No retraining, calibration, blend tuning, model selection or deployment from these scores.
limitations: Cohort previously scored; recipe selected using contemporaneous Stockholm outcomes, so not a fresh blind or operational replay test.
Diagnostic bypasses only the offline unsupported-pool guard. Backend guard, model weights and configuration remain unchanged.
